verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Hölder step itself is stated verbatim in cutoff_transport_bound: ∫ φ^6‖w‖^3 ≤ ‖w‖_2^{3/2} ‖φ^4 w‖_6^{3/2}, exactly the paper's exponents (6 on the cutoff, 3 on |w|, 3/2 on B_R). Two routine rewritings. (i) The Lean keeps the factor ‖w(t)‖_2^{3/2} explicit where the paper absorbs it into C_T; the paper licenses this on p. 121 (‖w(t)‖_2 ≤ C_T on [0,T]), and WholeSpaceComparisonClosure does the same absorption at line 123–133 using hM : ‖(u-v)(t)‖_2 ≤ M. (ii) The prefactor CR^{-1} appears in the Lean as 8L with L a Lipschitz bound for φ; for φ_R(x) = φ(x/R) the Lean supplies L = derivativeConstant 1 / R (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff_fderiv_le, used at WholeSpaceComparisonClosure.lean:121), so 8L = C/R. The Lean's φ^6 arises from bounding φ^7 ≤ φ^6 in norm_fderiv_cutoff_eight_apply_le (line 66), which is the paper's |∇χ_R| ≤ CR^{-1}φ_R^7 ≤ CR^{-1}φ_R^6 chain; the paper's 'v = w on supp ∇χ_R' is the Lean's hvanish hypothesis.
